# hostd_public_ip_ptr (Resource)

Reverse DNS (PTR) for a public IP that is already reserved on a project. The address itself is not created here: it comes from a VM or stays reserved in the project. Destroy restores the default hostname and leaves the address in place. Import with `<project_id>,<ip>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hostd_public_ip_ptr" "web" {
  project_id = hostd_vm.web.project_id
  ip         = hostd_vm.web.ipv4
  content    = "web.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) PTR hostname, for example `vm.example.com`.
- `ip` (String) Public IPv4 or IPv6 address.
- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project the address belongs to.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment stored with the address. Empty by default.

### Read-Only

- `attachment` (String) `vm`, `router` (Cloud Gateway), or empty when the address is only reserved.
- `status` (String) `attached` or `reserved`.
- `vmid` (Number) VMID when the address is attached to a VM.
